definitions: A large, edible nut with a hard, wrinkled shell and a distinctive flavour.
The tree that produces walnuts, typically a deciduous tree of the the genus Juglans.
The wood of the walnut tree, valued for its strength, grain, and colour, used in furniture and veneers.
examples: She cracked a walnut with a nutcracker.
The garden has an old walnut tree.
The antique desk was made of solid walnut.
